OpenConsole

Share a terminal. No inbound ports.

Whoever is sharing gets a ticket from openconsole. Paste it here, or just open the link they sent you.

Prefer a terminal? Or want to share your own?

To join, you need nothing installed — this page is enough.

An ssh client works too:

ssh <session-id>@this-relay

The session ID is the part of the ticket before the first dot. Paste the part after it when asked for a token. Encrypted sessions cannot be joined this way — an ssh client has no key.

To share your own terminal, install the client: 

curl -fsSL https://openconsole.dev/install.sh | sh

Then run openconsole. It prints a ticket and a link to send to whoever is joining. Read the script before you run it — it downloads a release binary from GitHub and does nothing else.

Rather build it yourself? go install github.com/SmugZombie/OpenConsole/cmd/openconsole@latest
